SELECT
  `products`.`sku` AS `code`,
  `products`.`price`
FROM `products`
WHERE `products`.`price` < 10
  AND `products`.`sku` LIKE 'A%'

SELECT
  `products`.`sku`,
  `tags`.`label` AS `tag`
FROM `products`
LEFT JOIN `tags` ON `products`.`id` = `tags`.`product_id`

SELECT
  "venues"."name",
  "events"."price" AS "cost"
FROM "venues"
FULL JOIN "events" ON "venues"."id" = "events"."venue_id"
WHERE "events"."meta" IS NOT NULL
  OR "venues"."capacity" >= 500

SELECT
  "items"."label" AS "name",
  "items"."price"
FROM "items"
WHERE "items"."price" <= 2
  AND "items"."kind" IN ('box', 'bag')

SELECT
  "moves"."qty",
  "items"."label"
FROM "moves"
INNER JOIN "stock" ON "moves"."stock_id" = "stock"."id"
LEFT JOIN "items" ON "stock"."item_id" = "items"."id"
